_about: Page numbers read by eye on the Internet Archive scan, for leaves the OCR and the consensus cannot settle, and pages missing from a scan. Keyed by IA item; 'leaves' maps the scan leaf to its printed page.  'mark' is appended to every page label of an issue whose printed numbers repeat another issue's. Every entry is listed in the volume's QA report. Add an entry only after looking at the scan.
